summary: The centuries-old roads in the UK capital present challenges that Los Angeles and San Francisco don’t.（原题：Uber, Wayve Launch Robotaxi Service in London to Compete With Waymo）

title: Uber 击败 Waymo 成为伦敦首个推出机器人出租车的公司
summary: Uber beat out Waymo in launching a commercial robotaxi service in London, the city's first. The vehicles use autonomous driving tech developed by Wayve, a UK-based startup, and will initially feature safety drivers behind the wheel. The launch is a milestone for Uber, which has been plotting a UK launch with Wayve for several years. […]（原题：Uber beats Waymo as first to launch robotaxis in London）

title: Hugging Face 的新型鸭子机器人正在快速销售。中国芯片为其提供动力
summary: The colorful "Microduck" robot from HuggingFace's French subsidiary Pollen Robotics has sold more than 10,000 units since launching on Thursday.（原题：Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it）
